scientific_integrity: The unrestricted inequalities and power norms are proved analytically. Finite rational checks are supporting diagnostics only. Historical priority is qualified by incomplete access to some specialized sources.
scientific_limitations: Finite, unweighted, loopless complete-split graphs; real vertex signals; degree-normalized one-step random walk and integer powers; unweighted complete-pair Gini seminorm. No claim for weighted graphs, lazy walks, or continuous-time heat.
title: Sharp classwise Gini dissipation for complete-split random walks
